MEET YOUR HOST

A heart for people.
A gift for the moment.

Every occasion has a story. Keira helps you tell it—with warmth, confidence, and the kind of energy that brings a room together.

Behind Dream Big Events Management is a host, inspirational speaker, and trainer who believes that meaningful events begin with a genuine connection. From the first welcome to the final applause, your moment is at the heart of it all.
